description: Source code implementing peer-to-peer access and fabric support functions for CUDA devices in PyTorch, including device initialization, peer access checks, and fabric memory handle support.

methods.name: init_p2p_access_cache
methods.description: Initializes the cache for peer-to-peer access between CUDA devices, setting default values and device count.

methods.name: get_p2p_access
methods.description: Checks and enables peer-to-peer access between two CUDA devices, caching the result.

methods.name: get_nvml_device
methods.description: Retrieves the NVML device handle for a given CUDA device, initializing NVML if necessary.

methods.name: isFabricSupported
methods.description: Checks if fabric memory handle exchange is supported on the current device by attempting allocation, export, and import of fabric handles.

methods.name: get_fabric_access
methods.description: Determines if fabric memory handle exchange is supported for a CUDA device, utilizing NVML and driver API checks.
